hint.analytics: Open the analytics setup of the app: the report access or the credential usually needs attention.
hint.approved: It is approved. Release it when you are ready.
hint.changesetFailed: The change could not be applied to the repository. Open it to see why and try again.
hint.ciFailed: Open the run in your CI to read the log, fix it and run it again.
hint.credentialInvalid: Test the credential. If the test fails, the key was revoked or expired: add a new one and replace it.
hint.drift: The store text no longer matches what you staged. Review the differences and pull or push.
hint.halted: Decide whether to resume the rollout or to fix the problem and release again.
hint.pendingStale: Changes have been waiting for a while. Review them and publish, or discard them.
hint.recoveryUsed: A recovery code was used. If this was not you, change your password and make new codes.
hint.rejected: Read the reason the store gave, fix it and send a new build for review.
hint.smtp: Alert emails are not getting out. Check the mail server settings and send a test.
hint.stalled: Look at what the release is waiting for: a build, a review or a person.
hint.stepupFailed: If this was not you, change your password and review the sign-in methods.
hint.sync: Open the app to see the reason. The usual cause is a credential that expired or lost access: test it on the Credentials screen and replace the key if the test fails.
hint.tokenCreated: If you do not know this token, revoke it.
hint.unanswered: Answering reviews is quick here: write a reply or let the assistant suggest one.
